description: This Java source file defines the ServiceGroupReader class, which manages reading and caching service group configurations from XML resources within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading configurations, parsing XML group definitions, and retrieving group models.

classes.name: ServiceGroupReader
classes.description: Final class responsible for reading, parsing, and caching service group configurations from XML resources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads service group configurations from service engine and component resources, parsing XML group definitions and populating the cache.

methods.name: addGroupDefinitions
methods.description: Parses XML resource to extract group definitions and adds them to the cache.

methods.name: getGroupModel
methods.description: Retrieves a GroupModel from cache by service name, reloading configuration if cache is empty.
